title: Fast heart rate over threshold
description: A heart rate above the fixed threshold makes the rules set High priority on their own. Follow the rule evidence, explanation and human review.

title: Critically low oxygen in ICU
description: An oxygen saturation below the critical threshold makes the rules set Critical priority, and the ICU unit sends it to the ICU team.

title: Heparin pump occlusion
description: An occlusion alarm sets High priority, and because the pump is running heparin the router adds a pharmacy consult.

alert.message_text: Occlusion alarm on primary IV line

title: Repeated nurse call
description: A nurse call with three repeats raises the priority under the rules and sends it to the charge nurse. Accept or override to inspect the append-only review trail.

title: Sepsis screen with two criteria
description: Temperature, heart rate and breathing rate meet the screening criteria, so the rules set Critical priority and route to the Rapid Response Team.

alert.message_text: SIRS criteria positive - sepsis screening alert

title: Dizzy patient getting up alone
description: A single bathroom call is Low priority under the rules, but the patient is on sedating medications, has a high fall-risk score and had earlier alerts today, and says they are dizzy and getting up alone. The rules alone would not raise it; the AI reviewer can raise the priority by one level, never lower it, and the router still picks the team. Needs the AI explanation service to be configured.

alert.message_text: Patient reports feeling dizzy and is trying to get up to the bathroom alone

title: Confused patient climbing out of bed
description: A single call is Low priority under the rules, but the message says the patient is confused and climbing out of bed after a sleeping pill and an opioid, with a high fall-risk score and three earlier alerts today.
